title: Status page names what is waiting on you and re-sends it to your inbox
deviations_from_card: Write-set growth, all guard/registry surfaces the brief anticipates: app/_lib/api-response.ts (3 codes: STATUS_RESEND_FAILED store; STATUS_NOTHING_TO_RESEND 409; STATUS_RESEND_UNDELIVERED 502, committed with the 4 catalogs under the lock), app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts (ALLOWED entry with reason, like the letter/nps siblings) and app/api/public-body-cap-contract.test.ts (EXEMPT: the door reads no body), plus a route-level test file status-resend.test.ts. public-routes.ts NOT touched: the existing /api/status/ prefix already admits [token]/resend. Acceptance 8 cases = 8 tests in candidate-next-action.test.ts (plus an INTERVIEW_LINK_TTL_DAYS drift pin) + the two payload key-set pins; 4 extra route tests. Truthful verdict vs probe-resistance: success/cooldown/no-contact answer the same relay-only sentence (resendMessageKey), but a send that was ATTEMPTED and returned failed/refused answers STATUS_RESEND_UNDELIVERED and clears the cooldown - never a green lie; this is the one answer that implies an address exists (documented in compliance README).
notes: Commit order: catalogs+codes (locked) -> limiter contract + api-reference (locked) -> tests -> feat -> compliance doc (locked). tsc: my paths clean; whole-tree red only on foreign paths (untracked kpi-sim/ tree and a sibling's in-flight app/features/insights/analytics/AnalyticsHeader.tsx MetricPackPreview casing). test:perf: the live tree was over on app/page.tsx (+2 modules) and ~14 routes by 1-8 KB, all from siblings' UNCOMMITTED files (metric-pack / group-eval-run); measured via git archive: base 0ad43cc7d, + my catalog/api-response commit, + my uncommitted files, and finally committed HEAD 78998932f are all 'within budget' (my share ~+1 KB on route graphs from api-response.ts, no app/page.tsx growth; new modules stay on the status route graph only). Full test:unit: my two guard breaks (capability-coverage, body-cap) fixed and in the feat commit; recipes-literals was a FLAKE that passes alone (not my files - card composes PANEL_ACCENT/EYEBROW/BTN_SECONDARY_LG). Known gaps recorded in the doc: a resent schedule/interview invite re-records its *_invite_sent event (the dispatchers write it unconditionally); take_interview reads latestInterviewByEntry, which prefers a transcript-bearing session. Both themes not visually verified (no dev server per brief); card is tokens/recipes only.
